name: search-hole
description: Your own search gateway for Claude: choose the engines and sites it searches, see every search, get source receipts.
long_description: search-hole is a local, open-source search gateway. It searches through engines you choose (a private SearXNG, Tavily or Brave), applies your source rules (block, allow, pin, raise and lower sites), and gives Claude a receipt of what was searched, hidden and opened. Everything stays on your computer: the search log, your rules and your keys. The receipt card in the chat lets you block a site Claude used with one click; Claude can only suggest rules, you approve them. Run `searchhole doctor` in a terminal, or open the dashboard with `searchhole ui --open`.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web through your engines and source rules, with dates, source types and a receipt.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Open a page safely (private addresses refused, your blocked sites respected) and read its text and dates.

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Show what was searched, hidden and opened, as a card you can act on.

tools.name: suggest_rule
tools.description: Propose a source rule for you to approve; it never applies anything itself.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key (optional)
tavily_api_key.description: The easiest free engine: 1,000 searches a month, no credit card. Sign up at https://app.tavily.com and paste the key. Stored in your system keychain.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key (optional)
brave_api_key.description: Optional extra engine with $5 of free credit a month (about 1,000 searches); it asks for a card. Sign up at https://brave.com/search/api/. Stored in your system keychain.
